summary.content:
Today's selection covers 100 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 60 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Reid Hoffman to Leave Microsoft’s Board of Directors
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Elon Musk is steamrolling Wall Street to become a trillionaire
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, The Verge, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 39 articles published in the last 24 hours
